# splunkctl

> splunkctl is a CLI and MCP server for operating Splunk Enterprise, Enterprise Security, and Splunk SOAR with guarded, previewable changes.

- [Home](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/README.md): splunkctl is a CLI and MCP server for operating Splunk Enterprise, Enterprise Security, and Splunk SOAR with guarded, previewable changes.

## Machine-readable

- [llms-full.txt](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/llms-full.txt): The home page and every operator guide in one markdown file.
- [commands.json](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands.json): The full command tree with parameters, defaults and guard markers, as printed by `splunkctl commands --json`.

## Get started

- [Install](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/install.md): Install splunkctl from PyPI on Python 3.12 or newer, add the browser extra when you need it, and verify the install with doctor.
- [Configure](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/configure.md): Set up splunkctl profiles for development, UAT, and production, and override them with environment variables or flags.

## Investigate

- [Run searches](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/search.md): Run SPL searches, export results, upload files, and manage search jobs on a remote Splunk instance.
- [Review fired alerts](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/alerts.md): Review fired alerts, inspect alert actions, and manage alert suppression on a Splunk instance from the terminal.
- [Triage ES notables](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/es.md): List, inspect, and bulk-triage Enterprise Security notable events by status, owner, urgency, disposition, and comment from the terminal.
- [Manage dashboards](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/dashboards.md): Export Splunk dashboards to files, keep them in version control, and create, update, share, or delete them with a preview before every change.

## Detect

- [Manage detection rules](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/rules.md): Export detection rules to YAML, review them in version control, and import them on another Splunk instance with a preview.
- [Manage ES correlations and threat intel](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/es-detections.md): List, inspect, enable, and disable Enterprise Security correlation searches, and upload or remove threat-intelligence items.
- [Manage macros, eventtypes, tags](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/knowledge.md): Manage search macros, eventtypes, and tags as objects instead of editing conf files by hand.
- [Check data model acceleration](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/datamodels.md): Inspect CIM data model definitions and acceleration health so tstats-based detections run on complete data.
- [Manage lookups](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/lookups.md): Upload, download, define, and wire lookup tables so detections can enrich events from files you control.
- [Manage source types and extractions](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/parsers.md): Manage source types, props, and transforms, and keep field extractions in YAML for review and deployment.

## Respond with SOAR

- [Set up and check SOAR](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar.md): Configure SOAR credentials in a splunkctl profile, confirm connectivity, and read SOAR version, health, license, settings, metrics, and vocabularies.
- [Work SOAR incidents](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-incidents.md): Find, create, update, assign, and close Splunk SOAR containers, and manage their artifacts, vault files, notes, and comments from the terminal.
- [Install SOAR apps](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-apps.md): List, inspect, install, and uninstall Splunk SOAR apps, and read an app's configuration schema before creating an asset for it.
- [Configure assets and monitor ingestion](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-assets.md): Create, update, test, and delete Splunk SOAR assets, then confirm that polling-based ingestion assets are healthy with ingest-status.
- [Run playbooks](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-playbooks.md): Export, import, run, and monitor Splunk SOAR playbooks and keep them as code in version control.
- [Run actions](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-actions.md): Run app actions on Splunk SOAR assets, wait for results, and inspect past action runs.
- [Manage custom functions](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-functions.md): List, inspect, import, export, and update Splunk SOAR custom functions.
- [Manage cases and workbooks](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-cases.md): Promote Splunk SOAR containers to cases, apply workbook templates, and work phases and tasks.
- [Handle approvals](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-approvals.md): List, approve, and deny approval requests raised by Splunk SOAR playbook prompt blocks.
- [Maintain custom lists](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-lists.md): Create, export, import, and edit Splunk SOAR custom lists row by row, with the full-replace behaviour of update made explicit before you apply it.
- [Look up indicators and evidence](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-indicators.md): Look up indicators of compromise across Splunk SOAR and manage evidence items on containers.
- [Ingest SIEM results into SOAR](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-ingest.md): Turn Splunk search results into Splunk SOAR containers and artifacts with an idempotent, previewable ingest command.

## Change safely

- [Manage configuration as code](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/state.md): Pull live Splunk and SOAR configuration, diff it against version control, and push approved changes with a change report.
- [Edit any conf file](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/conf.md): Read and edit any Splunk configuration file and stanza over the REST confs API when no dedicated command group covers it.

## Give it to an agent

- [Set up the MCP server](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/mcp.md): Register splunkctl as an MCP server so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client can run its commands with the same guard.

## Operate and audit

- [Log in through browser SAML](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/auth.md): Complete Splunk and SOAR SAML single sign-on, including a second factor, in a browser and reuse the session from every splunkctl command.
- [Diagnose a connection](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/doctor.md): Diagnose connection, authentication, server health, and user permissions for the active splunkctl profile before doing real work.
- [Manage indexes](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/indexes.md): Create, configure, and delete Splunk indexes with a preview before every change.
- [Manage data inputs](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/inputs.md): Manage monitor, TCP, UDP, scripted, and HTTP data inputs on a Splunk instance.
- [Manage HEC tokens](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/hec.md): Create, enable, disable, and remove HTTP Event Collector tokens, adjust HEC settings, and send test events.
- [Manage apps](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/apps.md): Install, update, reload, and uninstall Splunk apps from local packages with a preview before every change.
- [Manage users and roles](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/users.md): Create, update, and delete Splunk users and roles with a preview before every change.
- [Check server health and topology](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/server.md): Read Splunk server health, license, KV store status, topology, deployment, authentication, tokens, and workload settings.
- [Manage KV store collections](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/kvstore.md): Create KV store collections and read, write, and delete their documents for allowlists and enrichment data.
- [Audit changes and attest RBAC](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/audit.md): Produce change-audit and role-based access control attestation reports from Splunk for regulators and reviewers.
- [Administer SOAR users and roles](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/soar-admin.md): Manage Splunk SOAR users, inspect role permissions, and query the platform audit trail.

## Reference

- [Exit codes](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/exit-codes.md): splunkctl uses three exit codes so scripts and CI pipelines can branch on success, failure, and usage errors.
- [Relationship to Splunk's splunkctl](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/splunk-cli.md): This project and Splunk's own splunkctl share an executable name and a config path but nothing else; here is how they differ and how to run both.
- [Contributor lab: Keycloak SAML](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/guides/keycloak-lab.md): Run the contributor Keycloak SAML lab in rootless Podman so you can exercise splunkctl's browser SAML login against Splunk and SOAR test VMs.

## Command reference

- [Overview](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/README.md): Index of the 26 splunkctl command groups, generated from the CLI.
- [alerts](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/alerts.md): Reference for `splunkctl alerts`: Manage fired alerts and alert actions.
- [apps](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/apps.md): Reference for `splunkctl apps`: Manage Splunk apps.
- [audit](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/audit.md): Reference for `splunkctl audit`: Change audit and RBAC attestation — regulator evidence, read-only.
- [auth](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/auth.md): Reference for `splunkctl auth`: Browser SAML login, session status, and logout for SIEM and SOAR.
- [conf](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/conf.md): Reference for `splunkctl conf`: Generic conf file/stanza editor (any conf, including sensitive ones).
- [config](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/config.md): Reference for `splunkctl config`: Manage splunkctl configuration.
- [dashboards](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/dashboards.md): Reference for `splunkctl dashboards`: Dashboard management.
- [datamodels](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/datamodels.md): Reference for `splunkctl datamodels`: CIM/tstats data models — definitions and acceleration health.
- [es](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/es.md): Reference for `splunkctl es`: Enterprise Security — notable-event triage (requires ES installed).
- [eventtypes](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/eventtypes.md): Reference for `splunkctl eventtypes`: Event classification rules (eventtypes.conf) — read-only.
- [global](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/global.md): Reference for the top-level splunkctl commands: commands, completion, doctor, info.
- [hec](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/hec.md): Reference for `splunkctl hec`: Manage HTTP Event Collector tokens.
- [indexes](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/indexes.md): Reference for `splunkctl indexes`: Manage Splunk indexes.
- [inputs](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/inputs.md): Reference for `splunkctl inputs`: Manage data inputs.
- [kvstore](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/kvstore.md): Reference for `splunkctl kvstore`: KV store — collections and document CRUD (allowlists, threat intel).
- [lookups](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/lookups.md): Reference for `splunkctl lookups`: Manage lookup table files.
- [macros](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/macros.md): Reference for `splunkctl macros`: Reusable SPL macro fragments (macros.conf).
- [mcp](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/mcp.md): Reference for `splunkctl mcp`: Built-in MCP server for agent integration.
- [parsers](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/parsers.md): Reference for `splunkctl parsers`: Manage source types and field extractions.
- [rules](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/rules.md): Reference for `splunkctl rules`: Manage detection rules (saved searches).
- [search](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/search.md): Reference for `splunkctl search`: Search and job management.
- [server](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/server.md): Reference for `splunkctl server`: Server operations — messages, license, KV store, topology health.
- [soar](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/soar.md): Reference for `splunkctl soar`: Splunk SOAR operations — platform reads, containers, playbooks.
- [state](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/state.md): Reference for `splunkctl state`: Unified config-as-code across rules, parsers, macros, lookups, dashboards.
- [tags](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/tags.md): Reference for `splunkctl tags`: CIM/eventtype tag assignments (tags.conf) — read-only.
- [users](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/commands/users.md): Reference for `splunkctl users`: Manage users and roles.

## Design

- [Architecture](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/design/architecture.md): How splunkctl is built: the layers, the request flow, and the design decisions behind them.
- [Catalog & status](https://splunkctl.danny.vn/design/catalog.md): Status of every splunkctl command group and core module, updated with the commits that move them forward.
